content: यज् €1 <ab>U.</ab> (यजति-ते, इयाज, ईजे; अयाक्षीत्-अयष्ट, यक्ष्यति-ते, यष्टुम्, इष्ट) {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} इज्यते; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} (यियक्षति-ते) .²1 To sacrifice, worship with sacrifices (often with <ab>instr.</ab> of words meaning ‘a sacrifice’); यजेत राजा कतुभिः <ls>Ms. 7. 79</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 53</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 36</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 40</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 90</ls>; so अश्वमेधेनेजे, पाकयज्ञेनेजे <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To make an oblation to (with <ab>acc.</ab> of the deity and <ab>instr.</ab> of the means of sacrifice or oblation); पशुना रुद्रं यजते <ls>Sk.</ls>; यस्तिलैर्यजते पितॄन् <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 105</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 119</ls>. .²3 To worship, adore, honour, revere. .²4 To consecrate, dedicate. .²5 To give, bestow. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (याजयति-ते) .²1 To cause to sacrifice. .²2 To assist at a sacrifice. .²3 To perform the office of the sacrificing priest; स वेदो याजयितुं ययौ <ls>Bm. 1. 42</ls>.
